name: artemis
description: A local-first cross-platform desktop coding agent powered by Pi.

scripts.build:gateway: npm run build -w @artemis/protocol && npm run build -w @artemis/gateway
scripts.test:im: npm run build:core && vitest run packages/gateway/test packages/protocol/test/im*.test.ts packages/agent-host/test/im-remote-tools.test.ts packages/agent-host/test/im-delegation-park.test.ts apps/desktop/test/im-*.test.ts apps/desktop/test/im-*.test.tsx
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:ui-foundation && npm run build -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @artemis/protocol && npm run build -w @artemis/platform && npm run build -w @artemis/agent-host && npm run build -w @artemis/gateway
scripts.build:ui-libraries: npm run build -w @artemis/theme-contract && npm run build -w @artemis/ui && npm run build -w @artemis/theme-artemis
scripts.build:ui-foundation: npm run build:ui-libraries && npm run build -w @artemis/ui-gallery
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.verify:screenshot-matrix: npm run build:core && npm run verify:screenshot-matrix -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.verify:goal-parity: npm run build:core && npm run verify:goal-parity -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.verify:desktop-skin: npm run build:core && npm run verify:desktop-skin -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.verify:form-controls: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @artemis/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-form-controls.mjs
scripts.verify:navigation-controls: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @artemis/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-navigation-controls.mjs
scripts.verify:secondary-pages: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @artemis/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-secondary-pages.mjs
scripts.verify:feedback-layout: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @artemis/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-feedback-layout.mjs
scripts.verify:conversation-timeline: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @artemis/desktop && node apps/desktop/scripts/verify-conversation-timeline.mjs
scripts.verify:ui-performance: npm run build -w @artemis/ui-gallery && node scripts/verify-ui-performance.mjs && node scripts/test-ui-performance.mjs
scripts.verify:ui-gallery: npm run build:core && npm run build:ui-foundation && npm run test -w @artemis/ui-gallery && npm run typecheck -w @artemis/ui-gallery && npm run build -w @artemis/desktop && node scripts/verify-ui-gallery.mjs
scripts.verify:skin-package: npm run build:ui-libraries && node scripts/verify-skin-package.mjs && node scripts/test-skin-package.mjs
scripts.verify:skin-conformance: npm run build:ui-foundation && npm run test -w @artemis/ui && npm run test -w @artemis/ui-gallery && node scripts/verify-skin-conformance.mjs && node scripts/test-skin-conformance.mjs
scripts.test: node --test scripts/test-pre-push.mjs scripts/test-slack-cli.mjs && npm run test:audit-production && npm run build && npm run test -w @artemis/gateway && npm run test -w @artemis/protocol && npm run test -w @artemis/platform && npm run test -w @artemis/agent-host && npm run test -w @artemis/theme-contract && npm run test -w @artemis/ui && npm run test -w @artemis/theme-artemis && npm run test -w @artemis/ui-gallery && node scripts/verify-skin-package.mjs && node scripts/test-skin-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-skin-conformance.mjs && node scripts/test-skin-conformance.mjs && npm run verify:ui-convergence && npm run verify:ui-boundaries && node scripts/verify-ui-package-consumer.mjs && node scripts/verify-ui-performance.mjs && node scripts/test-ui-performance.mjs && node scripts/verify-ui-gallery.mjs && npm run test -w @artemis/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run build:ui-libraries && npm run typecheck -w @artemis/theme-contract && npm run typecheck -w @artemis/ui && npm run typecheck -w @artemis/theme-artemis && npm run typecheck -w @artemis/ui-gallery && npm run typecheck -w @artemis/desktop
